name: com.fidemcheck/fidem
title: Fidem
description: Checks the company behind an online shop before an AI agent pays. Facts with source and date.

tools.name: consultar_tienda
tools.description: Checks an online shop by its domain using public sources and returns dated facts, each with its source. Use it before paying at a shop you or your user do not know. Free, no key needed. It reports: whether the shop publishes a signed Merchant Verification File (MVF standard) and who it belongs to; which company the website says it is and whether that company exists in the official register (VIES for EU VAT numbers, Companies House for the UK); when the domain was registered; the first archived copy of the site; its TLS certificate; the return window the shop states, with a quote; whether the domain appears in open phishing lists; and whether the shop's robots.txt lets AI agents in ("acceso_agentes": abierto, parcial or cerrado, with the agents it blocks). How to read it: "nivel" is "verificada_por_la_tienda" only when the shop proved it controls the domain and Fidem signed it; otherwise "consulta_publica". Each check has a "codigo": confirmado / en_registro / en_certificado mean confirmed; sin_dato or sin_comprobar mean Fidem could not check (not a bad sign); no_publicado means Fidem did not find that fact on the pages it read (see "nota"), not that the shop hides it; no_en_vies means the VAT number is well formed but not in VIES, which does not prove the company does not exist; en_lista means the domain is on a phishing list. Field names are in Spanish. It gives no score and no buying advice, and says nothing about product quality or delivery.

dominio.description: Shop domain or URL, for example shop.com
